purpose: Native Hindi/Telugu emotion data registry and reproducible preprocessing record
policy: No machine-translated English or Chinese data is presented as native Hindi/Telugu evidence.

sources.name: BHAAV (भाव) - A Text Corpus for Emotion Analysis from Hindi Stories
sources.license_or_terms: Software repository MIT; corpus terms permit research use, require citation/credit, and request permission for commercial use
sources.notes: Narrative sentences from 230 stories; keep separate from conversational dialogue results.

sources.name: Telugu Emotion
sources.license_or_terms: CC BY 4.0 as declared by the Hugging Face dataset card
sources.notes: Native Telugu single-sentence classification; preserve original train/validation/test files.

sources.name: MaSaC ERC — Hindi-English Code-Mixed Emotion Recognition in Conversations (SemEval-2024 Task 10 EDiReF Sub-Task 1)
sources.license_or_terms: No explicit license file upstream; standard shared-task research use assumed — cite SemEval-2024 Task 10 (EDiReF) and MaSaC. Verify terms before any commercial use.
sources.role: Hinglish dialogue emotion recognition (auxiliary; code-mixed romanized, not native Devanagari benchmark data)
sources.notes: Romanized Hinglish TV-show dialogues (per-utterance 8-class labels, 446 dialogues / 11,440 utterances). Official splits can share the same episode across train/val/test — group_id is episode, re-split for leakage-safe evaluation. No intensity labels.

sources.name: Doctor-Patient Indic Speech Dataset
sources.license_or_terms: CC BY 4.0 as declared in repository README; speaker consent basis beyond that declaration is undocumented
sources.language: hi, te (+ 7 other Indic languages, parallel English transcript)
sources.role: ASR/diarization smoke-test sample only - NOT benchmark data, NOT emotion data
sources.notes: Sample scale only: exactly 1 scripted two-speaker clinic dialogue per language (9 total). The Hindi and Telugu transcripts are parallel translations of the same scripted template (same 'Dr. Mehta' conversation) - scripted, not natural conversation. No emotion labels, no speaker-turn markers, no timestamps. Must not be emitted as AttuneBench conversation records: consent fields would be fabricated (schema consts require real consent). Use only to smoke-test audio/transcript tooling. Local raw copy removed 2026-09-02 (unused); checksums above remain the provenance record - re-clone from URL if ever needed.

sources.name: M2H2: A Multimodal Multiparty Hindi Dataset for Humor Recognition in Conversations (ICMI 2021)
sources.version: GitHub commit 7ad321bb9f01b581a025742114a9aca9b62ed3aa (sparse checkout: Main-Dataset/Raw-Text only; Raw-Audio/Raw-Visual fetchable from same commit)
sources.modality: text (aligned audio/visual segments exist upstream, not downloaded)
sources.role: auxiliary multiparty native-script Hindi dialogue with humor labels and speaker/listener structure; scripted TV, humor is not emotion
sources.notes: NATIVE DEVANAGARI text (not romanized as first assumed) from TV show 'Shrimaan Shrimati Phir Se'. 13 episodes, 136 scene-dialogues, 44 speakers. 129 rows skipped: 123 malformed/empty + 6 unlabeled ('nan') - labels never fabricated. Episode-level splits (train 5,300 / dev 408 / test 477) via normalize_m2h2.py, seed 20260828. Reproducible byte-identical.

sources.name: CMU Document-Grounded Conversations - Hinglish (DoG)
sources.license_or_terms: CC BY-SA 3.0 / GFDL as declared on the Hugging Face card
sources.role: auxiliary Hinglish human-human dialogue (task-grounded movie chat; no emotion labels)
sources.notes: 259 two-party crowdworker conversations (mean 38.5 turns, max 182), each grounded in one Wikipedia movie document (verified: zero sessions span >1 document). Source splits preserved (validation mapped to dev). Hinglish side human-typed; English parallel treated as auxiliary reference (HF card's machine-generated tag is ambiguous). Normalized via normalize_hinglish_dog.py (project .venv, pyarrow). Reproducible byte-identical.

sources.name: Telugu Emotion Speech (Sowmith et al. 2024, Kaggle)
sources.license_or_terms: Apache 2.0 as declared on the Kaggle dataset page
sources.version: Kaggle download 2026-08-31 via user account (ego-browser); zip sha256 da045d0e79da1c973aafc0aedd99e8febec5e84b4704311c60d1f376f629abd7
sources.role: auxiliary Telugu acted speech-emotion (small; first licensed Telugu SER audio found)
sources.notes: 458 acted .wav files (KuralHub survey said 468 - actual zip contains 458): anger 96 / joy 94 / neutral 103 / sadness 80 / surprise 85. Source folder names contain upstream typos ('nuetral', 'suprised'); labels normalized to project vocabulary. Index: data/processed/sowmith_telugu_ser_audio.jsonl (split unassigned - assign by speaker/content hash if ever used for training). Smoke-test scale, acted speech.

cmu_hinglish_dog_dialogue.note: no labels; dialogue structure/register resource; source splits preserved (validation mapped to dev)

sowmith_telugu_ser_audio.note: acted Telugu speech-emotion audio index; label folders normalized (nuetral->neutral, suprised->surprise); no text transcripts

not_suitable_as_primary_attunebench: The downloaded sources are emotion-classification resources: BHAAV/Telugu are sentence-level, MaSaC ERC is per-utterance dialogue classification — none is a native multi-turn preference benchmark.
They do not provide user goals, preferred response behavior, or complete human response comparisons.
The project still needs a separate native human-annotated conversation set for the primary emotional-intelligence result.
